text:
maya-marketing: Quick ask for the "Micro Playbook: Inference Economics" launch. Need a tight visual bundle we can reuse across socials, LP, and the webinar. Priority deliverables (order):
1) 1 "cost × SLO" matrix slide (4 quadrants) that maps latency buckets to cost strategy 
2) 3 social tiles (square 1:1, landscape 16:9 hero, story 9:16) + 2 alt-copy variants for A/B
3) 1 inbound routing microdiagram (webinar CTA -> LP -> 3-email nurture -> SDR) with example UTMs
4) one-page printable benchmark card (PNG + fig) with 2 illustrative numbers (annotate as "indicative")
5) accessibility color pairs + quick brand-compliance checklist

Constraints: mobile-first sizes, full lockup on hero, stacked logo for small tiles, include tiny legal footer on benchmark card: "Illustrative metrics; results may vary." Deadline: first drafts in 48 hours. Assigning Priya as design lead and Harper for motion-friendly frames. Noah, you own the routing copy + UTMs.

priya-design: On it. Two visual directions I'll push: "Matrix-first" (compass/grid + numeric callouts) and "Narrative" (icon-led flow). Quick Qs: do we want numeric callouts to include $/k tokens and ms latency buckets? and any strict copy length for story tile?

maya-marketing: Yes include numeric callouts but label them clearly "indicative". Latency buckets: <50ms, 50-200ms, 200-500ms, >500ms. For story tile keep headline <= 6 words.

harper-motion: I'll structure layers for easy keyframe export and provide a 5s story loop + 3 hero frames. I'll keep token-sparkline and cost-number separate layers. Will deliver PNG keyframes + MP4 stub. Tagging Priya for layer naming conventions.

noah-growth: Routing UTMs sample: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=micro_playbook_q2. Suggested CTAs: "Watch demo & claim credits" / "See predictable inference in action". Nurture subject lines to test: A) "How to make inference costs predictable" B) "Reduce inference surprises in production". I'll also prep a simple spreadsheet mapping sources -> tags.

priya-design: Draft color tokens for AA contrast test:
```
--rdw-primary-700: #0b3d91
--rdw-primary-500: #3461d3
--rdw-accent-400: #ffb547
--rdw-text-900: #0b0b0b
```
I'll generate a high-contrast alt and mark which combos pass AA for 14px body and 24px hero.

legal-bot: NOTE: Any numeric claim referencing cost reduction must include qualifier text. Recommended footer: "Representative example; individual results depend on workload and configuration." Flag if you include specific percent claims (e.g., "3x").

priya-design: Good call, we'll avoid absolute % claims and keep numeric callouts as sample rates (e.g., "$2.1 per 1k tokens — sample workload"). Adding tiny legal footer to benchmark card.

design-bot: EXPORT CHECKLIST (auto): include Figma link; artboards: 1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920, 1920x1080; exports: PNG 1x/2x, MP4 (story), layered .fig, PDF one-pager; include color tokens and font files; provide AA pass/notes and logo lockup variants.

harper-motion: I'll sync with Priya on layer names now. Will also output a Lottie JSON fallback for the hero loop. ETA: first frames in ~36h.

noah-growth: I'll drop the UTM spreadsheet and 3-email nurture draft into the shared drive tonight and add recommended subject lines.

maya-marketing: Perfect. We'll review drafts in tomorrow's 11am PT check. Thanks everyone — prioritize the matrix slide + benchmark card first. :sparkles:
